description: List the most recent OBSERVED → STALE edge transitions. Use this to spot integrations that have gone quiet — a CALLS edge that just went stale typically means an upstream stopped calling, not that the link is healthy.

edgeType.description: Filter by edge type — e.g. "CALLS" or "CONNECTS_TO"

project.description: Project name when the core hosts more than one (set NEAT_PROJECTS=...). Omit to use the default project.

name: get_recent_stale_edges
